moods.mood_description: Seize Pataliputra and the throne before Susima consolidates
Life or death for Ashok and his rivals
The crown won by murder weighs before it is worn
Ashok and Radhagupta against Susima's Brahmin faction
Rain as footsteps; the palace after massacre
Order justifies violence; the throne demands blood
This is the night that Kalinga will later answer
He gains an empire and loses the silence of his own mind
